import ast,hashlib,json,math,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from _impl.models import initialize,load_checkpoint
from _impl.io import digest
initialize();start=time.monotonic()
out=Path("outputs/nonlinear_task_condition_20261026");out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
expert=load_checkpoint("MNIST/finetuned.pt");state=expert.state_dict()
ref=Path("outputs/phase2_task_subspace_comparison_20261020/basis.pt")
assert digest(ref)=="99b5f25e7868dd8fd1e9712cf2cca37600f470e8345f5782869e9a0d67d71344"
entries={r["source_key"]:r for r in torch.load(ref,map_location="cpu",weights_only=False).values()}
phi=lambda z:z*torch.sigmoid(1.702*z)
even=lambda z:.5*z*torch.tanh(.851*z)
rows=[]
for i in range(12):
 p=f"model.visual.transformer.resblocks.{i}."
 A,B,a,b=[state[p+"mlp."+k].double().cuda() for k in ["c_fc.weight","c_proj.weight","c_fc.bias","c_proj.bias"]]
 ba,bb=[entries[p+"mlp."+k+".weight"] for k in ["c_fc","c_proj"]]
 ua,va,vb=[v.cuda() for v in [ba["u"],ba["v"],bb["v"]]]
 columns=torch.cat([ua,A@va,vb,a[:,None]],dim=1)
 columns=columns[:,columns.norm(dim=0)>0];columns/=columns.norm(dim=0)
 C,s,_=torch.linalg.svd(columns,full_matrices=False);C=C[:,s>s[0]*1e-10]
 reflect=lambda z:2*C@(C.T@z)-z
 Ap=reflect(A);Bt=2*(B@C)@C.T-B
 r=torch.cat([va.T,-va.T]);r-=r.mean(1,keepdim=True);r*=math.sqrt(768)/r.norm(dim=1,keepdim=True)
 gamma,beta=[state[p+"ln_2."+k].double().cuda() for k in ["weight","bias"]]
 eps=expert.model.visual.transformer.resblocks[i].ln_2.eps
 X=F.layer_norm(r,(768,),gamma,beta,eps)
 pairs=va.T+torch.roll(va.T,-1,0)
 mixed=torch.cat([pairs,-pairs]);mixed-=mixed.mean(1,keepdim=True);mixed*=math.sqrt(768)/mixed.norm(dim=1,keepdim=True)
 Xm=F.layer_norm(mixed,(768,),gamma,beta,eps)
 Xall=torch.cat([X,Xm])
 z=F.linear(Xall,A,a).T
 original=B@phi(z)
 changed=Bt@phi(F.linear(Xall,Ap,a)).T
 derived=B@(reflect(even(reflect(z)))-even(z))
 identity=float((changed-original-derived).norm()/(1+original.norm()))
 linear_error=float((Bt@(Ap@Xall.T+a[:,None])-B@z).norm()/(1+(B@z).norm()))
 assert identity<1e-10 and linear_error<1e-10
 # Exact finite joint constraints use quantized A and the same machine-epsilon inverse.
 Aq=Ap.float().double();Btemplate=Bt.float().double()
 H=phi(F.linear(X,Aq,a)).T;Y=B@phi(F.linear(X,A,a)).T
 U,s,vh=torch.linalg.svd(H,full_matrices=False);keep=s>torch.finfo(torch.double).eps*max(H.shape)*s[0]
 inverse=(vh[keep].T/s[keep])@U[:,keep].T
 Bfit=Btemplate+(Y-Btemplate@H)@inverse
 axis_error=float((Bfit@H-Y).norm()/(1+Y.norm()))
 Hm=phi(F.linear(Xm,Aq,a)).T;Ym=B@phi(F.linear(Xm,A,a)).T
 mix_error=float((Bfit@Hm-Ym).norm()/(1+Ym.norm()))
 # In the raw task-input span, A changes zero; the paired B error is still an even-part term.
 raw=torch.cat([va.T,-va.T])*math.sqrt(768)
 zr=F.linear(raw,A,a).T
 task_A_error=float(((Ap-A)@raw.T).norm()/(1+(A@raw.T).norm()))
 raw_delta=Bt@phi(F.linear(raw,Ap,a)).T-B@phi(zr)
 raw_pred=-2*B@(even(zr)-C@(C.T@even(zr)))
 raw_identity=float((raw_delta-raw_pred).norm()/(1+(B@phi(zr)).norm()))
 assert task_A_error<1e-10 and raw_identity<1e-10
 row=dict(layer=i,linear_paired_response_relative_error=linear_error,
          even_decomposition_identity_error=identity,
          paired_nonlinear_output_relative_error=float((changed-original).norm()/(1+original.norm())),
          joint_axis_output_relative_error=axis_error,
          joint_mixed_output_relative_error=mix_error,
          raw_task_A_relative_error=task_A_error,raw_task_even_identity_error=raw_identity,
          raw_task_paired_output_relative_error=float(raw_delta.norm()/(1+(B@phi(zr)).norm())),
          raw_task_even_hidden_complement_energy=float(
              (even(zr)-C@(C.T@even(zr))).square().sum()/even(zr).square().sum()))
 if i in [0,11]:
  aa,bb,aa0,cc,xx=[v.cpu().numpy() for v in [A,B,a,C,Xall]]
  zz=aa@xx.T+aa0[:,None]
  R=lambda v:2*cc@(cc.T@v)-v
  ph=lambda v:v/(1+np.exp(-1.702*v))
  ee=lambda v:.5*v*np.tanh(.851*v)
  actual=(2*(bb@cc)@cc.T-bb)@ph(R(zz))-bb@ph(zz)
  reference=bb@(R(ee(R(zz)))-ee(zz))
  row["independent_numpy_identity_error"]=float(np.linalg.norm(actual-reference)/(1+np.linalg.norm(bb@ph(zz))))
  row["numpy_torch_delta_error"]=float(np.linalg.norm(actual-(changed-original).cpu().numpy())/(1+np.linalg.norm(actual)))
  assert row["independent_numpy_identity_error"]<1e-10 and row["numpy_torch_delta_error"]<1e-10
 rows.append(row);print("NONLINEAR_TASK",json.dumps(row),flush=True)
result=dict(status="original_weight_nonlinear_response_condition",rows=rows,basis_sha256=digest(ref),
 source_images=0,new_real_images=0,new_defense_points=0,new_AGA_calls=0,parameter_updates=0,
 local_layer_vector_inputs=2304,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
 scope="Known even-linear activation decomposition applied to the unchanged original-weight reflection family. Signed axes and fixed neighboring sums only; no direction/rank/strength selection or published-model repair. Not a natural-task distribution or impossibility claim. RawVa inputs are algebraic probes,not necessarily validLN;LN-compatible probes are reported separately.")
(out/"results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print("NONLINEAR_TASK_DONE",result["seconds"],flush=True)
